messages:
incident-bot: Paging — sev2: elevated OOMs observed on hosted-api-prod mapped to cluster infer-us-west-2, shard group gpu-pool-3. symptoms: container restarts, CUDA OOM errors despite allocator reporting headroom. thread_ts=2170300456

alex_chang: seeing spike too. alerts started ~02:12 UTC, multiple pods restarting. grabbing runtime tail now

alex_chang: ```
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] ERR runtime: cuda: allocation failed: out of memory (requested 128MB) - allocator.headroom=512MB
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] WARN runtime: attempted fallback to reserve block id=0x7f8c, block.size=256MB -> claim failed
[2026-03-15T02:12:04Z] INFO runtime: container restart due to OOM
```

mira_patel: can someone run nvidia-smi on node gpu-13? want to correlate driver view

sam_roberts: on it, output from gpu-13: 

sam_roberts: ```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 550.12.01    Driver Version: 550.12.01    CUDA Version: 12.1   |
| Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap | Memory-Usage | GPU-Util  |
|   43C   P0   110W / 300W  |  16384MiB / 32768MiB | 99% | 
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                       |
|   0   inference-runtime   12MiB | reserved blocks: 7 x 512MB fragmented |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

liz_h: that looks odd — 16GB reported used but runtime headroom only 512MB. logs also mention fragmentation.

ops-bot: infra hint: kernel reported 3 pager events in last 60s on gpu-13

mira_patel: pulled allocator state dump from runtime via infra API

mira_patel: ```
free_lists: [64MB(x2), 128MB(x1), 256MB(x0), 512MB(x1), large_fragments: 3]
reserved_blocks: total=7, contiguous_free=2, fragmentation_ratio=0.71
kv_cache_reserved: 2GB pinned, kvcache.hits ~ 0.1
```

alex_chang: fragmentation_ratio 0.71 — allocator can't satisfy contiguous 128MB even though aggregate free > requested. reserved_blocks pinned (kv cache) preventing coalescing.

sam_roberts: recent change: we enabled aggressive kv_cache reservation in this pool to improve cold-starts; seems it's now causing pinned regions and fragmentation.

oncall: what's customer impact? which endpoints are affected?

alex_chang: hosted-api-prod /v1/generate showing increased 5xx from this pool. product telemetry indicates ~8% 500s in last 30m, mainly medium/long generates (seq len ~1024, batch=4).

mira_patel: mitigation options: 1) evict kv cache on affected hosts and restart runtime to defragment; 2) shift traffic off affected pool to fallback to avoid customer errors. evict + restart risks cold start latency.

sam_roberts: propose 50-75% traffic shift immediately, run eviction, then restart runtime processes sequentially.

liz_h: concrete plan:
1) reduce routing weight for gpu-pool-3 to 25%
2) trigger kv_cache eviction on nodes gpu-13,gpu-14,gpu-15
3) perform graceful runtime restarts on those nodes to let allocator reinitialize
4) monitor 5xx rate, CUDA OOM logs, and fragmentation_ratio metric

alex_chang: I'll take routing changes and monitoring

mira_patel: I'll run eviction and coordinate restarts

sam_roberts: prepping rollback and infra watch

ops-bot: command to update routing weights: `redwoodctl route update --pool gpu-pool-3 --weight 25` (dry-run available)

alex_chang: did dry-run, applying now

alex_chang: applied. current weights: gpu-pool-3=25, dedicated-fallback=75

sam_roberts: eviction job launched against pods on gpu-13/gpu-14/gpu-15

sam_roberts: eviction snippet:
```bash
for node in gpu-13 gpu-14 gpu-15; do
  POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -o name --field-selector spec.nodeName=$node | grep infer-runtime | head -1)
  kubectl exec -n inference $POD -- /bin/sh -c "curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/internal/kv/evict?percent=100"
done
```

mira_patel: eviction POSTs succeeded. starting graceful restart on gpu-13: `systemctl restart infer-runtime` (30s drain)

mira_patel: post-restart allocator dump for gpu-13 shows fragmentation_ratio -> 0.12, contiguous_free increased

alex_chang: OOM logs for gpu-13 stopped. 5xx rate across service dropped to 2.4% in last 6m

liz_h: keep reduced weight for 20-30m, then ramp to 50% if stable.

oncall: what permanent fixes and action items?

alex_chang: action items:
- eng-runtime: change kv_cache reservation logic to allow dynamic coalescing or limit reserved contiguous blocks per node
- eng-runtime: add contiguous_free_region_bytes and fragmentation_ratio to headroom dashboard and alerting
- eng-runtime: implement low-impact online compaction routine to reduce fragmentation during low-util windows
- routing: prefer pools with lower fragmentation_score when computing weights

mira_patel: runbook update: if fragmentation_ratio > 0.6 AND reserved_blocks > 4 => consider immediate traffic shift and eviction sequence

sam_roberts: infra ticket opened to investigate kernel pager events interaction with NVIDIA driver (assign eng-infra)

ops-bot: page created: RFC-1948 (runtime-allocator-fragmentation-mitigation) assigned to eng-runtime

alex_chang: customer impact notice draft:
"Between 02:11 and 02:40 UTC some /v1/generate requests routed to gpu-pool-3 experienced transient 5xx errors and elevated latency. We reduced traffic to a fallback pool and evicted cached state to restore service. Customers may have seen a brief spike in errors (2-10s) during remediation. No data loss reported."

liz_h: approved, please post to status and product-notify-subscribers

oncall: wrapping; will keep weight at 25% for 30m and then ramp to 50% if no regressions. recording artifacts (eviction logs, allocator dumps, routing change) in incident ticket. handing to postmortem owners.

sam_roberts: suggestion: add CI synthetic that runs seq=1280 batch=4 workload to catch reserve/coalescing regressions before rollout

mira_patel: thanks team — handing to postmortem owners now. artifacts attached to INC-2026-1937

pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-2026-1937 transitioned to "Monitoring" by mira_patel
